# function: realm_config

Builds the RealmConfig message from an object and returns its protojson encoding, the value `authwise_realm.config` takes: the same string `data.authwise_realm_config` exposes as `json` for the same arguments, with the same attributes and checks. Requires Terraform 1.8 or later.

Use it in place of the data source to keep plans quiet. Terraform reads a data source at apply whenever a resource named in its arguments has a change planned, so `authwise_realm.config` plans an update that applies as a no-op; this function is evaluated at plan whenever its argument is known.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authwise_realm" "this" {
  display_name = "Customers"
  config = provider::authwise::realm_config({
    default_locale = "en"

    provisioning = {
      self_signup                = true
      require_email_verification = true
    }

    recovery = {
      self_service_reset = true
      reset_ttl          = "30m"
    }

    bot_protection = {
      mode       = "ALWAYS"
      provider   = "TURNSTILE"
      site_key   = "0x4AAAAAAA"
      secret_ref = { name = authwise_secret.turnstile.name }
    }
  })
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
realm_config(config dynamic) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `config` (Dynamic) An object with the attributes of `data.authwise_realm_config`, snake_case as there. Unset attributes are left out.
